chapter_title_en: A Dusk Wedding & the Double Joy God
chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 185: A Dusk Wedding and the Ominous Double Joy God
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang’s escort team stops for a wedding feast, but the joyful atmosphere shatters when the ceremony invokes the Double Joy God—a being more terrifying than the Xi Shen.
og_description: What’s more terrifying than a corrupted god? Watching everyone cheerfully pray to it.
twitter_description: When the gong announces “Bowing to the Double Joy God,” Li Huowang sees the horror in a room full of blissfully ignorant smiles.
